name: Curro Holdings Limited
summary: Curro Holdings Limited develops, acquires, and manages independent schools in South Africa, Namibia, and Botswana. The company operates through Curroa and Meridian segments. It operates nursery, primary, and high schools offering balanced academics, sports, and culture. The company also operates Curro Academy and Meridian schools, which accommodate learners from age five to grade 12; Curro Castle nursery schools; Curro schools that accommodate learners from age three to grade 12; and Curro Select schools that accommodate learners from age of three months to grade 12. The company operates 76 campuses with approximately 62,689 learners. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Durbanville, South Africa. Curro Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of PSG Financial Services Limited.
